war_summary: War 139 is on day 98 with no winner declared and conquest conditions not yet met. The front is sharply divided: Colonials hold full or near-full control across many regions (AcrithiaHex, AllodsBightHex, AshFieldsHex, DeadLandsHex, FarranacCoastHex, etc.), while Wardens dominate others (BasinSionnachHex, ClansheadValleyHex, HowlCountyHex, ReachingTrailHex, ViperPitHex, etc.). The heaviest fighting is concentrated in a handful of contested zones—CallahansPassageHex, ClahstraHex, EndlessShoreHex, MarbanHollow, MooringCountyHex, OarbreakerHex, SpeakingWoodsHex, and StlicanShelfHex—where casualty rates are accelerating and strategic bases are actively flipping. Several of these show recent ownership changes within the last 24 hours, with ClahstraHex, EndlessShoreHex, MooringCountyHex, OarbreakerHex, and StlicanShelfHex displaying the highest event volumes. Meanwhile, quieter regions show stable ownership with minimal combat, suggesting the strategic pressure is localized to these active corridors.
